title: Paul Thomas Anderson’s ‘Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall’ Concert Movie Acquired by Janus Films, Criterion
content: Janus Films and Criterion have acquired North American rights to “Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall,” a concert film shot and directed by Paul Thomas Anderson. The concert was captured on 35mm and 16mm film during a sold-out solo performance from the Geese frontman at Carnegie Hall in December 2025. Geese kicked off its Getting Killed world […]
